According to the text, 
The residual moisture in the water-based NMC532 cathode was 625 ppm at 20 °C.
After drying at 120 °C, the residual moisture was 47 ppm.
In comparison, the NMP-processed NMC532 cathode had 200 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C, which was reduced to 87 ppm after drying at 100 °C.

So, the water-processed NMC532 cathode lost 578 ppm of residual moisture (625 - 47) between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C.
The final value of 47 ppm for the water-processed cathode is lower than the final value of 87 ppm for the NMP-processed cathode.
